exchanges: Right, I'm home, I've showered, and I'm lying on the sofa with the dog on top of me like a hot water bottle.
That sounds like the best way to end a night shift.
He's a whippet so he's all legs and elbows, but he's warm, so it's fine.
Long legs, but good company.
Lucy took him out this morning before I got back, she's a legend. She was chatting to him in Welsh the whole way because she's learning it for her nan.
He is probably bilingual by now.
Oskar is still in bed, he's got a late start today.
Nice for him.
He's an electrician so his hours are all over the place too, which is probably why we get on.
Odd hours bring flatmates together.
My brother Malik sent me a video of his daughter Amina learning to ride a bike and I cried a bit, tiredness does that to me.
Night shifts make everything feel bigger.
She's five and completely fearless.
That is a great age for it.
Then Sven, my brother in law, sent one of his boy Elias doing the same thing, so now they're competing over whose kid is braver.
A friendly family rivalry.
Honestly the family chat is chaos.
Most family chats are.
Rania's thirtieth is coming up, she's booked out the Tramshed for it.
That will be a big night.
I have to swap a shift to go, Gloria might let me.
Hopefully she can make it work.
She's my ward sister and she's lovely if you bring her food.
Food is a good way to win people over.
She told me plantain is the one thing she'd eat every day until she died.
That makes the gift easy.
Ha, yes, I'll fry her some.
She will appreciate that.
I swim on Tuesday mornings after nights, it's the only thing that stops my back seizing up.
A good way to loosen up.
I learned at uni in Bangor, they had an amazing pool.
A good place to pick it up.
I miss it sometimes, the sea was right there.
Uni towns can feel like home.
Oskar just got up, he says morning.
Morning to him.
Oh, I got that wrong earlier, he retrained ages ago. He's a plumber now, not an electrician. I keep forgetting.
Good to know.
He says the pay is better.
That helps.
I've got Adele on in the background, she always calms me down.
Good choice for winding down.
I'm going to try and sleep by ten.
Sounds like a plan.
The dog is snoring now.
Sounds peaceful.
Rania just sent me the dress code for her party, it's all gold.
Sounds glamorous.
I don't own anything gold, the last thing I bought was a green Barbour jacket.
Maybe borrow something gold then.
Wait, what's my brother in law's kid called again? I want to send him a card.
Lucy's back from the shops.
Good timing.
She reminded me her birthday is in February and she wants a proper cake this year.
Better start planning then.

earlier_question.right_reply: Sven's little boy is called Elias.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Sven's little one is called Amina.

questions.message: What breed is my dog again? The vet form is asking.
What month does Lucy turn a year older?
Right, phone's going face down, night night.
What does Lucy do for work?
Sorry, what's Sven's little boy's name?
